notes: Deployed Shop v0.6.25 checkout.create wire (Vercel dpl_4vFLiuKLe7EAr8CMKXmrZEuA6y65). The checkout wire files (transaction-commands.ts, useMarketplaceCheckout.ts, wire-casing.ts, postal-address.ts, and the checkout builder in commerce.ts) are unchanged from v0.6.22 (55a084c8); marketplace-transaction.ts changed only by a 10 s timeout on the public payment-config read.
Wire keys are snake_case. Shop builds camelCase then toSnakeCaseWire at POST /v1/commands.
Every line whose cart item resolves a listing variant carries variant_id; variant_options is added only when that variant has options.
Shipping line includes fulfillment=shipping and a delivery_address object with name, line1, line2, city, region, postal_code, country_code.
Pickup-only checkout omits delivery_address entirely and sets fulfillment=pickup. Presenting an address on pickup is rejected.
Region values cover free text, ISO suffix, and PT empty.
Option B: checkout.create does not hold; POST /v0/orders/{id}/payment-method acquires hold_source=bind.
